title: Lupin Sansei: Pyramid no Kenja
native_title: ルパン三世 ～ピラミッドの賢者～
overview:
Following the discovery of a mysterious inverted pyramid in Egypt, master thief Lupin and his crew head straight there looking for a treasure hidden within, a jewel called "The Eye of Muiran". But with an ancient curse, mysterious soldiers, and Inspector Zenigata from Interpol all after Lupin, it won't be as easy as just walking in and taking it.

Lupin the 3rd: Pyramid no Kenja is a 3D stealth action game based on the Lupin the 3rd anime and manga franchise. The player controls Lupin as he moves through each stage; while he can directly attack enemies with his fists and gun, it is much more effective to sneak up behind enemies to incapacitate them. The goal of each of the 14 stages is to avoid the enemies and traps, find the hidden treasures, and unlock and reach the exit to the next stage. Jigen and Goemon also appear in certain stages to help Lupin out.
